title: NCIS
subtitle: Across the Eras
blurb: Twenty-three seasons of the Major Case Response Team. Pick a showrunner era, a roster, a big bad, an arc or a vibe — and find the episodes worth rewatching.
regularsNote: The MCRT regulars (Gibbs, Tony, Kate, Ziva, McGee, Abby, Ducky, Palmer, Bishop, Torres, Sloane, Kasie, Knight, Parker, Vance…) aren't listed per-episode — use the roster rows on the chart for them.
chartHint: Click any bar to filter episodes by that era. Click a season number to filter by season. Shift-click to combine.
